assets.name: garden-route-v2
assets.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story, environment asset for a children's English learning journey.
Image 1 and Image 2 are the previously approved environment STYLE references. Restore their richly connected terraced Mediterranean garden town: warm cream limestone walking routes, rounded coral salmon masonry, arches, small steps, cypress trees and lush flowers, warm sunlight from upper left, painterly polished 3D storybook finish. Match those references closely; do not redesign the palette or invent a new fantasy world.
Create one continuous tall portrait landscape backing plate, ideally 1024x3072 (1:3). It will sit BEHIND separate character courtyards and short connecting bridges. This is a decorative environment, with no characters and NO large circular empty platforms, NO island discs, NO three marked destinations, NO text or UI. The terrain must feel connected and grounded. Most of the scene is cream stone architecture and lush green vegetation, not open water. Use coral arched walls and small passageways along both sides, warm cream meandering garden walkways between them, dense green-and-yellow foliage and daisies, glimpses of shallow turquoise canals only in narrow gaps beneath arches. No large central sea and no blue ocean horizon. Keep the middle 55% visually quieter with small texture and soft greenery so separately rendered courtyards can sit in front. Ensure architectural details also appear near the inner thirds, not exclusively at the outermost edges. Keep the same top-down three-quarter camera and small-scale texture as the references. Upper and lower ends are both landscaped stone/greenery, no sky and no vignette, so the scene reads as a continuing route. No people, objects from lessons, stars, medals, pins, numbers, labels, logos, screenshots, frame, or checkerboard.

assets.name: stone-link-v2
assets.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Make a transparent raster connecting bridge for the existing warm storybook learning-journey environment.
Image 1: approved original terraced town style reference. Image 2: open courtyard edit reference showing the exact cream limestone/coral masonry/green foliage palette to match.
Create one S-curved elevated cream-stone walkway with coral salmon arched sidewalls, a few short steps, small cypress/flower planters, viewed from the SAME upper-left-lit three-quarter overhead viewpoint. No people, no circular plaza, no isolated island, no ocean, no ground background, no text, UI, numbers, stars, glow or vignette. Genuine transparent background. Canvas 1536x1024.
This is a connector from an upper courtyard on the RIGHT to a lower courtyard on the LEFT. Its open walkable TOP end must reach the top edge near x=90% (between 80%-100%); follow the right side down to y=40%, sweep left through the lower middle, then exit the LEFT edge near y=90% (between 80%-100%). Endings are flat open cream paving that can tuck behind neighboring courtyard paths. The path should bend around the center upper region x20%-70%,y0%-45%, leaving that region transparent for course labels. The bridge path itself is thick and tangible, with open arch windows and lush edge planters like the reference, not a diagrammatic line. Its width is about 15%-20% of the canvas width. No fenced-off ends. Keep all significant arch bodies inside the canvas. Soft ambient contact shadow only under masonry, no broad halo.
